svg.title: From the car to the manual gearbox
svg.desc: The standard six-speed manual sits behind the 2010 2.9 engine. Its clutch faces the engine; the final drive sends torque sideways to the rear wheels. Follow engine torque through the flywheel, single dry clutch and gearbox. Pedal, master cylinder and hydraulic line command a separate slave/lever release; the cabin lever selects gears through two cables. Numbered parts: 1 Engine interface; 2 Dual-mass flywheel; 3 Dry clutch; 4 Clutch release; 5 Pedal and master; 6 Gearbox and input; 7 Synchroniser and fork; 8 Lever and cables; 9 Final drive and shafts. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
